info.title: Mandate Hackathon API
info.description: Contract-first prototype: one trusted FastAPI transaction service, scoped agent access, independently retained audit checkpoints and a bounded verification component. HKD only. All payments simulated. See README.md for normative transaction, delegation and evidence requirements.

post.summary: Approve a purchase waiting for review
post.description: Owner only. Grants a one-time waiver of the listed review reasons; the agent then calls POST /authorizations again with the same transaction_id and a new Idempotency-Key. Hard rules (budgets, caps, merchants, expiry, revocation) are re-checked then. 409 unless pending and the mandate chain is active. Proposed v0.2 addition (wallet, Timmy). Additive: v0.1 clients can ignore it.

bearerAuth.description: Server resolves an opaque configured credential to actor ID, role and authorized resources. Do not accept role/owner from request headers or body. Separate demo user and agent secrets; do not expose user secret to the agent.

ReasonCode.description: VELOCITY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, APPROVAL_DENIED and APPROVAL_EXPIRED are Proposed v0.2 addition (wallet, Timmy). RISK_REVIEW_REQUIRED is a proposed v0.3 addition (wallet, Timmy): normally a review reason; it refuses only when the reason cannot be put to the owner (new since their approval, or too many purchases already waiting). Additive: older clients can ignore it.

conditions.description: Applicability of the observation, e.g. basket threshold, delivery area, membership.

unit_price_minor.description: Observed unit price in HKD cents; never a float.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an explicit UTC offset.

anyOf.description: Optional threshold; exceeding it returns requires_review with an approval_request the owner can approve or deny before it expires.

velocity_limit.description: Optional; omitted means no velocity limit. Proposed v0.2 addition (wallet, Timmy). Additive: v0.1 clients can ignore it.

risk_review.description: Optional; when true, purchases that fit every hard rule but look unusual (first purchase on this mandate, first order from a new shop, a basket at least 3x the usual size, items never bought before, a unit price at least 25% above the last price paid) return requires_review with RISK_REVIEW_REQUIRED reasons. A child mandate must keep it on if its parent has it on. Listing text that tries to instruct the agent is always reviewed, whatever this is set to. Proposed v0.3 addition (wallet, Timmy). Additive: older clients can ignore it.
